headline: Cristiano Ronaldo to start for Portugal in sixth World Cup
summary: The 41-year-old legend makes history alongside Lionel Messi as Portugal faces DR Congo in their Group K opener in Houston.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo will start for Portugal in their World Cup Group K opener against Democratic Republic of Congo in Houston on Wednesday.
At 41, Ronaldo is featuring in his sixth World Cup since debuting in 2006, a record he shares with Argentina's Lionel Messi.
Portugal's lineup includes Bernardo Silva, who starts on the day his move to Real Madrid was confirmed by the LaLiga club.
The Portuguese defense will see Tomas Araujo and Renato Veiga as centre-backs, replacing the injured Ruben Dias.
DR Congo returns to the World Cup for the first time in 52 years, with Yoane Wissa and Cedric Bakambu starting up front.
Portugal enters the match having appeared in seven straight global finals and nine overall.
caption:
6 World Cups, 1 legend. Cristiano Ronaldo makes history once again as he starts for Portugal in Houston!

Cristiano Ronaldo will start for Portugal in their World Cup Group K opener against Democratic Republic of Congo in Houston on Wednesday.

At 41, Ronaldo is featuring in his sixth World Cup since debuting in 2006, a record he shares with Argentina's Lionel Messi.

Portugal's lineup includes Bernardo Silva, who starts on the day his move to Real Madrid was confirmed by the LaLiga club.

The Portuguese defense will see Tomas Araujo and Renato Veiga as centre-backs, replacing the injured Ruben Dias.

DR Congo returns to the World Cup for the first time in 52 years, with Yoane Wissa and Cedric Bakambu starting up front.

Portugal enters the match having appeared in seven straight global finals and nine overall.
